text: As the firm navigates its future, we should carefully consider whether to migrate to the new records platform. Although the vendor claims to have an audited rollback path, this doesn't necessarily mean the technology is seamless. The automated cross-linking of case files is a key factor, but it's crucial to also evaluate the potential impact on our existing workflows and user experience. While the vendor's ability to eliminate combined license fees is a plus, it's essential to assess how this feature will affect our operations and whether it aligns with our business goals. Ultimately, we should weigh the benefits of the new platform against the potential drawbacks and make a decision that aligns with our strategic objectives.
